mckinsey-tech-trends-2022-018.note: Quote and footnote confirmed (2022 PDF p.96) and Gartner (Jul 2025) security services 2025 = $83.8bn (+21%, partial), but Precedence Research puts 2025 cybersecurity services (professional incl. integration, support, consulting + managed) at $177.3bn (-43%, miss); estimates of the same quantity span >2x, so under D23 the claim is ungradable, not partial. Graders used one estimate only.

mckinsey-tech-trends-2023-005.note: Quote confirmed (2023 PDF p.22). Stanford AI Index 2024: gen AI funding nearly octupled to $25.2bn in 2023; 2024 edition: gen AI equity investment $36bn, job postings +111% 2022-23, growth across each quantitative dimension. Hit under D30.

mckinsey-tech-trends-2023-006.note: Quote confirmed (2023 PDF, Talent market). 2024 edition scoring page: gen AI job postings +111% 2022-23 on the same series. Hit.

mckinsey-tech-trends-2023-014.note: Quote confirmed (2023 PDF). Wikipedia: Meta Quest 3 released 10 Oct 2023 (after July publication); PS VR2 22 Feb 2023. New headsets throughout 2023 -> hit.

mckinsey-tech-trends-2023-026.note: Wikipedia: Starship IFT-1 20 Apr 2023, Vulcan first launch 8 Jan 2024, New Glenn NG-1 16 Jan 2025. Two of three in the 2023-24 window, third in the year after -> partial (D30). Starship before publication but inside the stated window, so the early-event rule does not bite.

mckinsey-tech-trends-2024-002.note: Quote confirmed (2024 PDF). AI Index 2025: org AI use 78% in 2024 vs 55%, gen AI private investment $33.9bn (+18.7%); Menlo Ventures: enterprise gen AI spend $13.8bn in 2024, 6x 2023. Dominant reading (organizations invest to scale gen AI) held; risk-mitigation component weakly shown (AI Index notes RAI action gap).

mckinsey-tech-trends-2024-011.note: NVIDIA FY2024 10-K: ~40% of Data Center revenue for AI inference; Google I/O 2025: 9.7T tokens/month a year earlier.
